cards.name: Stealth Bird
cards.officialText: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Des Lacooda
cards.officialText: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Draw 1 card.

sharedMechanic.manualIgnition: Once per turn during Main Phase, controller changes this face-up card to face-down Defense Position.
sharedMechanic.marker: Per physical UID plus card-lifetime epoch; persisted in TagDuel JSON; consumed even when negated or source leaves before resolution.
sharedMechanic.trigger: Mandatory Flip Summon only; normal summons and effect flips do not trigger.
sharedMechanic.stealthBird: Deal exactly 1000 LP damage to the opposing team; check lethal/tie.
sharedMechanic.desLacooda: Draw exactly one from the active representative of the controlling team; if Deck empty, lose by failed draw; if hand exceeds 6, do not discard until End Phase.
sharedMechanic.sourceRemoval: A Flip Summon trigger plan already activated resolves even if the source leaves the Monster Zone before resolution.
sharedMechanic.tagOwnership: Controller team comes from the shared Monster Zone; physical owner comes from UID. A stolen card resolves for its controller; Des Lacooda draws to the active representative's Deck/hand.
